typescriptPath.description: Path to the `typescript` instance that will be used for checking.

configFile.description: Path to the `tsconfig.json` that describes the program. Searched for upwards from `context` when unset.

compilerOptions.description: Compiler options to override the ones the config file sets.

build.description: Build the projects the config file references first, the way `tsc -b` does, and report what the whole solution finds.

memoryLimit.description: The most memory, in MB, the JavaScript heap of the worker the check runs on may hold for its program (Node's maxOldGenerationSizeMb for that thread). Over it, the check reports so and starts from nothing on the next build. Memory outside the heap is not counted, and a --max-old-space-size given to Node takes its place. Unset, the worker may hold as much as Node gives a thread. At least 16: below that a thread cannot even start.

mode.description: What the check writes as well as reports: `readonly` writes nothing, `write-tsbuildinfo` writes only `.tsbuildinfo`, `write-dts` writes declarations with it, and `write-references` writes everything the compiler emits. Defaults to `write-dts` under `build`, where a project reads the declarations of the one it references, and `readonly` otherwise.

diagnosticOptions.description: Which kinds of diagnostic to report. Every kind is reported unless it is turned off here; `build` reports the whole of what it finds either way.
